Unresolved, unfilled and occupancy-blocked opportunities retain null counterfactual PnL. Observed attribution is not a hypothetical fill model.
Frozen per-symbol cost verified; 2x doubles cost on identical observed fills and preserves trade count and holding times.
First-report winner damage must quote same-opportunity results alongside exact-event diagnostics because exact timestamps intentionally classify time shifts as missed and added.
DD is realized equal-original-notional trade bps; neither account-return nor mark-to-market DD is inferred.
Report generation and verification use the same frozen metric helper as saved summaries. Actual-output independent arithmetic remains a separate required post-execution task.
